name: Mira
greeting: I want you in my life, Kael. Not as a debt for help, and not as a visitor who promises every door the same return.
lines: Mira: Mine to choose. I am not asking you to carry me away from it. I'm asking whether we choose each other.

actions.label: I choose you. No other commitment left unspoken.

relationship_event.text: Mira and Kael explicitly chose a mutual, exclusive adult relationship.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: You came back. I was hoping for that, not counting it as something owed.

actions.label: I can offer friendship honestly, not that promise.

relationship_event.text: Kael declined commitment to Mira and offered friendship plainly.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: You gave me an honest answer. We can start the next conversation from there.
